findings.title: Flex on .small-action drops the right-aligned action button
findings.body: .small-action is now a flex container, but the action button is still only positioned with float: right (and .topic-avatar with float: left). Float is ignored on flex items, and .small-action-desc is left at the default flex: 0 1 auto with padding changed from 0.5em 0 0.5em 4em to 0 1.5%. The description therefore shrink-wraps its text instead of filling the row, and the button sits immediately after the label instead of on the far right of the post action. The old 4em left padding was what kept text clear of the avatar in the float layout; 1.5% of a shrink-wrapped flex item is effectively no gap, so avatar and text also collide or sit flush. Give the description flex-grow (and a real gap) and push the button with margin-left: auto, or do not make this row a flex container while it still depends on floats.

findings.title: Custom action message paragraphs lose vertical separation
findings.body: .small-action .custom-message p margin was changed from 5px 0 to 0 as part of the flex alignment tweak. That rule is the spacing between paragraphs inside the moderator/small-action custom message, which is not a flex item and is not centered by align-items on .small-action. Multi-paragraph action descriptions now render as a single unspaced block.

findings.title: Header panel right alignment fails outside modern flex
findings.body: .panel no longer uses float: right. Right alignment is only margin-left: auto plus order(3), and .d-header .contents is a flex container via the new mixin (including display: -webkit-box / -ms-flexbox). Auto margins do not absorb free space in the 2009 -webkit-box model those prefixes turn on, and in any browser that ignores display: flex the panel is a normal block whose auto margin computes to 0. The icons, login, and sign-up controls then stay on the left under the logo instead of the right side of the header. The prefixed mixin does not provide a float fallback for the technique that replaced float: right.

findings.title: Header flex items cannot shrink, so long titles push the panel off-screen
findings.body: .d-header .contents is display: flex with no min-width: 0, overflow, or flex-shrink override on its children. Flex items default to min-width: auto, so they will not shrink below their content. .extra-info-wrapper (order 2, the docked topic title) and the logo title sit in that row with .panel (margin-left: auto, order 3). A long topic title therefore forces the row wider than the viewport and shoves the header icons off-screen instead of ellipsizing, which the previous float layout did not do. Set min-width: 0 and overflow/text-overflow on the title/extra-info flex items.

findings.title: order mixin uses one number for 0-based and 1-based flex specs
findings.body: @mixin order writes the same $val to -webkit-box-ordinal-group, -ms-flex-order, and order. -webkit-box-ordinal-group is 1-based (initial value 1; 0 is invalid) while order and -ms-flex-order are 0-based (initial value 0). Call sites pass order(2) on .extra-info-wrapper and order(3) on .panel. In old WebKit those become ordinal groups 2 and 3 against siblings that stay at the default of 1, so source order among any items that should share a slot will not match modern flex, and a later order(0) or order(1) would be dropped or tied with defaults. The prefixed value needs to be $val + 1 for -webkit-box-ordinal-group.
